title: Using AI to offer personalized health advice
title_zh: 利用人工智能提供个性化健康建议
abstract: The use of artificial-intelligence tools in medicine is increasing. What types of technology might be on the horizon and how can such health-advice tools be tested?
abstract_zh: 人工智能工具在医学中的应用越来越广泛。未来可能出现哪些类型的技术？此类健康建议工具应如何进行测试？
